account: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) researchers presented their proof of concept at the COMSNETS conference in Bengaluru, held from 6 to 10 January 2025, where they described lessons and gaps. The system uses semantic communication and generative AI to support a virtual 3D demonstrator. In the ITU account of June 2025 the TCS team describes an initial proof of concept and its intended use in remote education and workforce training. The team states that the first implementation lacks the desired real-time performance. The team also states that the semantic encoding still runs at the endpoint and has yet to move to an edge computing facility. No source reports a completed learning, training, or access outcome.
